content.title: Eli Lilly's Rare Weight Loss Data Miss Could Benefit Competitors
content.summary: On Thursday, Eli Lilly and Co.’s (NYSE:LLY) weight loss rival Novo Nordisk A/S (NYSE:NVO), along with smaller firms, Terns Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ:TERN), Viking Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ:VKTX), and Structure Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ:GPCR) are trading higher. What Happened Lilly released topline data from the Phase 3 ATTAIN-1 trial evaluating orforglipron that showed an average weight loss of 12.4% (27.3 lbs) compared to 0.9% (2.2 lbs) with placebo, below the 15% expectations.
